scientific_integrity: Analytic proof covers all real circular BV functions and arbitrary nonidentity positive Poisson mixtures. The standalone computer checks corroborate identities and example asymptotics only; no computer enumeration is presented as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar circular variation and normalized L2 only.
Mixtures must be probability measures on [0,1] with positive mass below radius one.
The fractional short-time asymptotics hold for fixed order, not uniformly through the half-order threshold.
An unindexed equivalent historical theorem remains a scientific priority risk.
Independent mathematical and historical-priority review not performed.
title: Universal antipodal extremizers and a half-order crossover for Poisson-mixture approximation
